name: Leaving A Church
overview: Scripture emphasizes the enduring nature of the church founded by Christ, assuring believers that the gates of hell will not overcome it (Matthew 16:18). While believers are called to faithfully assemble and encourage one another (Hebrews 10:25), they must also be vigilant against those who cause divisions or distort the gospel (Romans 16:17; Galatians 1:7). Leaving a church, therefore, should be approached with caution, ensuring that the unity and purity of the gospel remain central, grounded in the love of God demonstrated through Christ (John 3:16).
